# UnifiedQR

> Free QR Code generator and tracker. Create, customize, download and manage QR codes for URLs, PDFs, contacts, SMS, email, WiFi and more.

## What is UnifiedQR?

UnifiedQR is a web application that lets users create, customize, track and manage QR codes — both static and dynamic. Static codes are free forever with no watermarks. It supports URL, PDF, multi-URL, vCard contact, plain text, app store link, SMS, email, phone call and social media QR code types.

## Who is it for?

- Creators & individuals: link-in-bio pages, Wi-Fi sharing, contact card QRs
- Small businesses: restaurant menus, shop catalogs, WhatsApp ordering, packaging
- Marketers: dynamic codes with editable destinations and scan analytics
- Teams & operations: bulk CSV creation for inventory, events and asset tags

## Key Features

- Free QR code generation, no watermarks, no sign-up required for static codes
- 34 QR design templates, custom colors, gradients, body shapes, eye styles, logos and CTA frames
- Download as PNG, SVG, JPG or PDF — all formats free
- Static codes (permanent data) and dynamic codes (editable destination + scan analytics)
- Real-time scan tracking: devices, countries, referrers, peak hours; CSV export
- Workspace: multi-link pages (like a bio page) with sections, sub-sections and brand icons — one QR code for all destinations, with page view and link click analytics
- Bulk creation from CSV with ZIP download (PNG/SVG/JPG) and links mapping
- 12 workspace templates grouped by use case
- Multi-language support — 29 languages with automatic detection

## Free vs Paid

- Free: unlimited static QR codes, all download formats, full design customization, 3 dynamic QR codes, 20 bulk codes per batch, country-level analytics, unlimited workspace pages
- Day Pass: ₹9 — 5 dynamic codes, 50/batch bulk, city-level analytics
- Week Pass: ₹49 — 15 dynamic codes, 100/batch bulk
- Monthly: ₹99 — 50 dynamic codes, 200/batch bulk
- Yearly: ₹999 — unlimited dynamic codes, 500/batch bulk

Every feature is free to try up to a limit; paid plans raise the limits and add city-level analytics and priority support.

## Sharing

All generated QR codes work publicly: static codes contain the data itself, dynamic codes redirect through public short links (qr.nxtgensec.org/r/slug), and workspace pages are public at qr.nxtgensec.org/p/slug. No login is ever required to scan.

## Technology

- Built with TanStack Start (SSR), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Supabase for authentication, database and realtime
- Cashfree for payment processing (INR)
